# Tukaram Consultancy Online

> Tukaram Consultancy Online is a Navi Mumbai-based online legal consultancy providing 31 services across Society Support, Corporate Compliance, Consumer Court, NRI Legal Services, Family & Domestic Law, Insurance Claim Support and Embassy Legal Support. "Your Compliance Partner" with 10+ years' experience, 500+ clients served, monthly / annual subscriptions and one-off legal products. Mediated, drafted, filed online — India-wide.

## Tukaram Consultancy Online
- [Home — Services, Process, Credentials & Contact](https://mtd006.github.io/tukaramconsultancyonline/): Overview of Tukaram Consultancy, the 31-service catalogue, four-step process, multi-disciplinary credentials and contact details for Navi Mumbai.
- [Online Portal — Register & Login](https://mtd006.github.io/tukaramconsultancyonline/portal.html): Tukaram Consultancy Online Portal — register, take a subscription or buy a specific legal product, then approach the consultancy online with your matter.
